title: Shrimp au Gratin
description: For a new way of eating shrimp, try this easy shrimp au gratin that's baked golden and crisp thanks to a Parmesan cheese and bread crumb topping.
ingredients: 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil, or to taste
30 uncooked medium shrimp, peeled and deveined
1 tablespoon chopped fresh parsley, or to taste

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).

Heat olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until butter melts. Reduce heat to medium, whisk in flour, and stir until a thick paste forms, about 5 minutes. Gradually whisk in milk and bring to a simmer. Cook and stir until sauce is thick and smooth, 5 to 10 minutes. Season with nutmeg and salt.

Place shrimp in a casserole dish and coat with 3 teaspoons Italian seasoning. Season with salt. Cover with sauce and sprinkle with Cheddar cheese. Add shallot, remaining 1 teaspoon Italian seasoning, and parsley on top. Sprinkle with bread crumbs, followed by Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven until crisp, about 25 minutes.
